name: Moero! Taiikukai-kei Musume Joshi Prowres Hen
original_name: 燃えろ!体育会系娘 女子プロレス編
source:
Mika Fukazawa is a female professional wrestler who is at the peak of her popularity.
One day, she is asked to compete in a handicap match between men and women, with the survival of the group at stake.
However, it was a dark professional wrestling venue where anything was possible, with no contact with the outside world.
And she gets her body defiled in front of a large audience...
